LESSON: MATCHING AND PAIRING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Pre-Number Activities
Topic 1.2: Matching and Pairing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Matching and Pairing, part of Pre-Number Activities in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How can you match clothes worn every day?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: learners talk to and work with each other while matching and pairing pictures of different

clothes.

Values:
Unity: learners work amicably together to accomplish the task of matching and pairing clothes and share with others.
